Ultra-realistic candid nighttime bedroom selfie of a young woman sitting in a black ergonomic gaming chair at her computer desk. She has long, straight dark-black hair with soft natural volume, wispy curtain bangs falling across her forehead, and loose strands framing her face. She has delicate youthful facial features, smooth natural skin, dark expressive eyes, subtle makeup, and a soft neutral expression. One eye is playfully closed in a wink while she looks toward the camera.
She is wearing an oversized black graphic T-shirt featuring a dark anime-inspired illustration and a simple pendant necklace. She raises one hand beside her face, making a cute peace/V sign near her cheek. Small silver hoop earrings and subtle ear piercings are visible. Her other arm extends toward the camera as she takes the selfie.
Cozy dimly lit gaming/study room at night. A laptop and desktop monitor glow on the desk, showing dark-themed screens, while a small digital clock displays 23:47. A keyboard gives off subtle purple-blue illumination. Manga/anime artwork and sketches are pinned across the wall behind her. A warm desk lamp creates a soft glow in the background, contrasting with the cool computer light. A drink sits on the desk in the foreground.
Authentic smartphone selfie aesthetic, slightly wide-angle front camera perspective, intimate bedroom atmosphere, low-light photography, realistic shadows, natural skin texture, detailed individual hair strands, realistic hands and fingers, subtle digital noise, soft contrast, cinematic nighttime mood, photorealistic, high detail, natural proportions, vertical 4:5 composition.
Negative prompt: cartoon, anime character, CGI, plastic skin, excessive beauty retouching, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, malformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, warped glasses, artificial hair, blurry face, oversaturated colors, unrealistic computer setup, excessive sharpening, text artifacts, watermark.
